what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Mali by conflict and violence, counted by IDMC and by UNHCR and shown side by side.
At the end of 2025, IDMC estimated 408646 people in internal displacement, and UNHCR counted 414524.
Refugees from Mali live mainly in Mauritania and Niger.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Mali from 2012 to 2025, at war level in 2022 and 2025, with groups including Ansar Dine, AQIM, MUJAO and JNIM.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group from 2017 to 2025, and over Azawad territory in several periods, with the FLA from 2023 to 2025.

when.text: IDMC's figure rose from 230000 in 2012 to 408646 in 2025, its highest.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2012 and 2013 and 2019 to 2025, and IDMC recorded the most new displacements from conflict in 2019.

how.text: In 2025 IDMC counts 5878 fewer internally displaced people than UNHCR; the figures overlap and are never added.
IDMC's new displacements count movements, not people: someone forced to move twice in a year is counted twice.
The sources don't say where inside Mali people moved to.
